arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Numeric values in the range [0, 1]. Missing values are allowed.

origin.details: The installed function is qlogis. Values of 0 and 1 return -Inf and Inf. A value outside [0, 1] is NaN and R warns "NaNs produced". Missing values stay missing. The help page still describes an error for values outside the unit interval; the function does not stop.
origin.value: The logits of the input values, with the same shape.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Numeric values in the range [0, 1]. Missing values are NaN.

translation.details: This is log(p) - log1p(-p), matching qlogis. Values of 0 and 1 return -inf and inf. A value outside [0, 1] is NaN and warns "NaNs produced". A scalar returns a float. An array keeps its shape.
translation.value: The logits of the input values, with the same shape.
